login.title: Sign In
login.subtitle: Global panel
login.tabsLabel: Sign in or create an account
login.introSignUp: Enter your email and choose a password. We'll email you a code to confirm it.
login.agree: By continuing you agree to our
login.failed: We could not sign you in. Please try again.
login.signUpFailed: We could not create your account. Please try again.
login.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
login.codeExpired: Your code expired or was typed wrong too many times. Sign in again and we will email you a new one.

invalidHub.title: Invalid sign-in link
invalidHub.heading: This sign-in link doesn't lead to a hub
invalidHub.message: The address it wanted to return to is not an ERPlora hub, so we stopped here. Open your hub and start the sign-in from its own screen.

notAMember.title: No access to this hub
notAMember.heading: You don't have access to this hub
notAMember.message: This account is not a member of {hub_host}. Ask whoever manages that hub to invite you, or sign in with the account that has access.

authenticationError.heading: We could not sign you in with Google
authenticationError.message: Something went wrong while signing in with Google. Try again, or sign in with your email and password.

loginCancelled.heading: Sign-in cancelled
loginCancelled.message: You cancelled signing in with Google. Try again, or sign in with your email and password.

googleLinkRefused.heading: Google was not linked
googleLinkRefused.message: Google can only be linked by signing in with the Google account of your email.

verifyEmail.title: Check your email
verifyEmail.sent: We emailed a code to your email address.
verifyEmail.resent: We sent you a new code.
verifyEmail.resendFailed: We could not send a new code. Please try again later.
verifyEmail.signInCodeHelp: The code lasts 3 minutes. Didn't get it? Sign in again and we will email you a new one.

passwordReset.title: Reset Password
passwordReset.subtitle: Reset your password
passwordReset.sent: We've sent password reset instructions to your email address. Check your inbox (and spam folder).
passwordReset.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
passwordReset.invalidLink: This password reset link has expired or is not valid.
passwordReset.done: Your password has been changed successfully.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
twoFactor.trustHint: You will not be asked for a code from your app here again for 14 days. Not on a shared computer.
twoFactor.trustLead: Your code is right. Do you want to trust this browser?
twoFactor.requiredToContinue: Turn on the authenticator app to continue.
twoFactor.loadError: We could not load your security settings. Please try again.
twoFactor.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
twoFactor.totpOnLead: You are asked for a code from your app after your password.
twoFactor.totpOffLead: Codes from an app such as Google Authenticator or 1Password, asked after your password.
twoFactor.recoveryUnused: {unused} unused — each one signs you in once if you lose your authenticator. | {unused} unused — each one signs you in once if you lose your authenticator.
twoFactor.recoveryAllUsed: You have used all your recovery codes. Generate a new set now.
twoFactor.recoveryNoneLead: Without them, losing your authenticator locks you out of your account.

trusted.title: Trusted browsers
trusted.lead: Browsers you trust skip the code from your app for 14 days.
trusted.unknown: We could not check this browser.
trusted.revoked: No browser is trusted now: each one will ask for the code from your app at its next sign-in.

activate.title: Set up your authenticator app
activate.lead: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then type the number it shows.
activate.cantScan: Can't scan? Enter this key by hand:

deactivate.title: Turn off the authenticator app?
deactivate.lead: You will sign in with your password and the code we email you.

codes.title: Recovery codes
codes.lead: Each code signs you in once if you lose your authenticator. Keep them somewhere safe.
codes.noneLeft: You have no codes left. Generate a new set now, before you need one.

regenerate.title: Generate new recovery codes?
regenerate.replaces: This replaces your {count} unused code. | This replaces your {count} unused codes.
regenerate.nothingLeft: You have no unused codes left, so nothing is thrown away.

reauthenticate.title: Confirm it's you
reauthenticate.subtitle: Account security
reauthenticate.passwordLead: Enter your password to change your sign-in security.
reauthenticate.codeLead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.

errors.network: We could not reach ERPlora. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong in ERPlora. Try again in a few minutes.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.loadError: We could not load your sessions
sessions.note: Closing a session also closes it in your businesses.
sessions.appMessage: The ERPlora app on {device} ({ip}) will sign out. If it is charging at a till, it will have to sign in again.
sessions.othersMessage: 1 session will be closed, also if it is an app. If it is charging at a till, it will have to sign in again. | {n} sessions will be closed, also the apps. If one is charging at a till, it will have to sign in again.

reauth.passwordLead: To keep your account safe, enter your password again.
reauth.googleLead: Your account signs in with Google: confirm it's you by signing in with Google again. You will come back here to finish.

email.addressHint: We will send a 6-digit code there. Your account keeps its current email until you type it.
email.codeLead: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Type it here: it works for 15 minutes.
email.resent: We sent a new code to {email}
email.wrongCode: That code is not right. Tries left: {left}.
email.codeSpent: That code no longer works: ask for a new one.

errors.unsupported: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
errors.unreadable: We could not read that image. Try another one.
errors.too_large: That image is too big, even made smaller. Try another one.

profile.heading: Your details
profile.pending: We sent a code to {email}: type it to start signing in with that address.
profile.saveHint: It turns on when you change something.
profile.loadError: We could not load your account

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.message: Your account, your photo, your preferences and your API keys are deleted, and every session ends, also in the apps and in your businesses. This cannot be undone.
delete.lead: Your account and what is in it go for good. Businesses you own have to be transferred or deleted first.
delete.owns: You own {n} business: transfer or delete it before deleting your account. | You own {n} businesses: transfer or delete them before deleting your account.
delete.pays: You pay for {n} business of other people: ask its owner to enter their own payment details before deleting your account. | You pay for {n} businesses of other people: ask their owners to enter their own payment details before deleting your account.
delete.loadError: We could not check your businesses
delete.loadErrorBody: You can delete your account once we know which businesses hold it. Check your connection and try again.

security.heading: Sign-in
security.twoFactorOn: After your password, a code from your authenticator app. Keep your recovery codes safe.
security.twoFactorOff: Ask for a code from an authenticator app after your password, so a stolen password is not enough.

preferences.loadError: We could not load your preferences
preferences.appearanceLead: «System» follows the light or dark mode of your device. The changes on this tab are saved on their own.
preferences.languageHint: Also the language of the mails we send you.
preferences.hubAlertsHint: A business is ready, a payment is pending.

keys.name: Name
keys.nameHint: To tell it apart later, e.g. the tool that uses it.
keys.once: You will see the whole key only once, when you create it. Keep it somewhere safe.
keys.copyNow: Copy it now and keep it somewhere safe: you will not see it again.
keys.copyFailed: We could not copy it: select the key and copy it by hand.
keys.title: API keys
keys.loadError: We could not load your API keys
keys.revokeMessage: Whatever uses this key stops working at once. It cannot be undone: you would have to create another one.
keys.empty: You have no keys yet. Create one to connect your tools with your ERPlora account.
keys.note: These keys are for the API of your ERPlora account. The keys of each business are created inside the business.

password.title: Change your password
password.wrongCurrent: The current password is not right.
password.hint: At least 8 characters; better long, and without your email.

strength.weak: Weak: avoid your email and use several kinds of characters.
strength.fair: Fair: a longer one is safer.

password.changed: Password changed. Your businesses will ask you to sign in again.
password.rowLead: Changing it asks you to sign in to your businesses again.
password.none: Your account signs in with Google and has no password yet: we email you a link to create one.

google.notConnected: Sign in with your Google account too.
google.onlyWayIn: It is your only way to sign in: create a password first.
google.howToLink: To link it, sign in once with the Google account of your email.
google.disconnectMessage: You will no longer sign in with {account}; you will keep signing in with your email and your password.
